pickup_reach.label: Pickup: reach
pickup_reach.help: How close she must stand to take an item with Up. 24 is about one and a half tiles.

pickup_lock.label: Pickup card: cannot close for
pickup_lock.help: Stops a mashed button from skipping the card. The first card holds this long.

special_pickup_time.label: Special pickup: show length
special_pickup_time.help: How long the light show runs before a weapon, ability or gear card opens.

input_swallow.label: After a card: ignored input
input_swallow.help: Seconds the key that closed a card is ignored, so she does not swing or jump.

drop_life.label: Drops: seconds on the floor
drop_life.help: How long an item, orb or scrap waits before it fades. Blinks the last 3 seconds.

drop_suture_weak.label: Drops: Suture from weak enemies
drop_suture_weak.help: The chance a weak enemy leaves a Suture.

drop_suture_other.label: Drops: Suture from other enemies
drop_suture_other.help: The chance any other enemy leaves a Suture.

orb_magnet.label: Soul orb: pull distance
orb_magnet.help: 0 means an orb is taken only by touch. Higher numbers pull it toward her.

soul_orb_chance_weak.label: Soul orb: chance from weak enemies
soul_orb_chance_weak.help: Weak enemies drop one this often. Every other enemy always drops one.

scrap_max.label: Scrap: gauge size
scrap_max.help: The most scrap she can carry.

scrap_per_pickup.label: Scrap: per pickup
scrap_per_pickup.help: How much one heap of machine scrap adds to the gauge.

scrap_drop_base.label: Scrap: chance at full health
scrap_drop_base.help: The base chance that a kill leaves machine scrap.

scrap_drop_low.label: Scrap: extra chance when hurt
scrap_drop_low.help: Added to the base chance as her health falls. At 10 percent health the chance is base plus 0.9 times this.

repair_hold.label: Self-repair: hold time
repair_hold.help: How long she holds still before the repair starts.

repair_rate.label: Self-repair: health per second
repair_rate.help: How fast she heals while the repair runs.

repair_cost.label: Self-repair: scrap per health
repair_cost.help: How much scrap one point of health costs.

heal_hold.label: Touch: hold before a take
heal_hold.help: A short guard so a passing finger does not take a touch item by accident.

rare_chance_weak.label: Rare drop: weak enemies
rare_chance_weak.help: The chance a weak enemy leaves its rare item.

rare_chance_trolley.label: Rare drop: trolley
rare_chance_trolley.help: The chance a trolley leaves its rare item.

rare_chance_choir.label: Rare drop: Hollow Choir
rare_chance_choir.help: The chance the Hollow Choir leaves its rare item.

rare_chance_moth.label: Rare drop: Censer Moth
rare_chance_moth.help: The chance the Censer Moth leaves its rare item.

rare_chance_scribe.label: Rare drop: Needle Scribe
rare_chance_scribe.help: The chance the Needle Scribe leaves its rare item.

rare_chance_crab.label: Rare drop: Reliquary Crab
rare_chance_crab.help: The chance the Reliquary Crab leaves its rare item.

rare_chance_warden.label: Rare drop: Ossuary Warden
rare_chance_warden.help: The chance the Ossuary Warden leaves its rare item.

rare_chance_strong.label: Rare drop: strong enemies
rare_chance_strong.help: The chance a strong enemy leaves its rare item.

rare_respawn_mult.label: Rare drop: respawn multiplier
rare_respawn_mult.help: A returned enemy rolls its rare drop at this fraction of the chance.

rare_stack_max.label: Rare items: stack cap
rare_stack_max.help: The most of one rare consumable she can carry.

rare_life.label: Rare drops: seconds on the floor
rare_life.help: How long a rare drop waits before it fades.

static_shard_mp.label: Static Shard: MP
static_shard_mp.help: How much MP a Static Shard restores.

ash_poultice_hp.label: Ash Poultice: HP
ash_poultice_hp.help: How much HP an Ash Poultice heals.

grave_salt_hp.label: Grave Salt: HP
grave_salt_hp.help: How much HP Grave Salt heals.

bile_flask_damage.label: Bile Flask: damage
bile_flask_damage.help: Extra swing damage while the Bile Flask lasts.

bile_flask_time.label: Bile Flask: seconds
bile_flask_time.help: How long the Bile Flask lasts.

trolley_bolts_scrap.label: Trolley Bolts: scrap
trolley_bolts_scrap.help: How much scrap Trolley Bolts adds at once.

hushed_bell_cut.label: Hushed Bell: damage cut
hushed_bell_cut.help: The fraction of incoming damage the Hushed Bell removes.

hushed_bell_time.label: Hushed Bell: seconds
hushed_bell_time.help: How long the Hushed Bell lasts.

steel_nib_damage.label: Steel Nib: damage
steel_nib_damage.help: Extra damage while the Steel Nib module is fitted.

chain_collar_def.label: Chain Collar: defence
chain_collar_def.help: Extra defence while the Chain Collar harness is fitted.

saint_rib_def.label: Saint Rib: defence
saint_rib_def.help: Extra defence while the Saint Rib harness is fitted.

tank_heart_hp.label: Tank Heart: max HP
tank_heart_hp.help: How much max HP a Tank Heart adds for good.

tank_heart_max.label: Tank Heart: cap
tank_heart_max.help: The most Tank Hearts she can hold.
